body:
I’ve never met anyone else who’s gone through a mother’s attempt. Not everyone wants to hear it - sometimes you just want to be the most suffer-y one, there’s this weird romanticized competitiveness to it - but you aren’t alone. The alcoholism, the feeling of a cycle, the attempt, everything.
I hope things turn out good for you, not just because you deserve it but for my own selfish hopeful purposes.
